Package index

Name Verification and Matching (COL)

Core functions for scientific name matching, clean 9-column verification, and homonym candidate inspection using the Catalogue of Life extended release.

Classification, Synonyms and Relationships (COL)

Universal ChecklistBank Interface (CLB)

Low-level complementary functions (clb_* family) for advanced queries against any specific ChecklistBank dataset or historical COL release.

clb_resolve_name() col_resolve_name() col_check_name() clb_check_name()
Resolve and verify valid species names
clb_match()
Match a scientific name against a ChecklistBank dataset
clb_match_checklist()
Match a checklist of names in bulk
clb_match_verbose()
Match a name and return all candidate usages
clb_classification()
Classification hierarchy of a taxon
clb_extract_classification() col_extract_classification()
Extract taxonomic classification from a match or usage result
clb_synonyms()
Synonyms of a taxon
clb_vernacular()
Vernacular (common) names
clb_distribution() col_distribution()
Geographic distribution for a taxon
clb_usage()
Get a name usage (taxon or synonym) by id
clb_usage_search() clb_search()
Full-text search of name usages
clb_suggest()
Autocomplete suggestions for name usages
clb_usage_metrics()
Metrics for a taxon
clb_tree()
Navigate the taxonomic tree
clb_children()
Direct children of a taxon
clb_dataset()
Get dataset metadata
clb_dataset_search()
Search datasets in ChecklistBank
clb_dataset_metrics()
Dataset metrics
clb_col_release()
Resolve a Catalogue of Life release
clb_col_releases()
List all Catalogue of Life releases
clb_base_url()
The ChecklistBank API base URL

ChecklistBank Parsers

Tools for parsing scientific names into atomic epithets and parsing controlled values.

clb_parse_name()
Parse scientific names
clb_parsers()
List the available ChecklistBank parsers
clb_parse()
Parse values with a ChecklistBank value parser
